hub.speaker: Krshia
hub.text: Hrr. My crate. Gone from the storeroom three nights past. Sewers, I think. Scavengers do not knock first.

text_variants.text: You come back. Any word on my crate?
Crate is home. You, I will remember. Yes.
You have the look of someone come to ask a favor. Speak plainly. I have no patience for the other kind.
The inn's order, extended. For the barmaid's sake, and yours. Do not make a habit of it.

options.text: The scavengers dragged it into a cellar. I've seen it myself. (Light)

options._comment: Q2 TALK path: the smooth-over. Progress-gated on heard_wrong_order (HIDDEN until Lyonette gives the quest), hidden once resolved -- so it never appears to crate_talk/social_loop/gate_district (which never bank heard_wrong_order). Banks the shared resolved_wrong_order (beat 1) + smoothed_with_krshia (Lyonette's TALK report gate) + persuaded_someone (the [Diplomat] identity feed, now a THIRD producer alongside watch_crate + zevara). class-gated (Diplomat) per the ratified persuade-fork rule; the ratified verb-label policy strips (Persuade) in favor of the class hint.
options.text: The inn's order ran short. Extend it, for Lyonette's sake. (Diplomat)

options._comment: re-pricing: the non-Diplomat alternate, same progress-gate scope as the Diplomat branch above. Own reaction node (smoothed_paid) so the persuaded branch's 'you speak plainly and you speak for a friend' line never gets misapplied to a plain cash make-good. persuaded_someone deliberately absent (paying isn't persuading).
options.text: Just cover the shortfall myself. (2 gold)

options._comment: Krshia's shop entry. ALWAYS-visible, ALWAYS-unlocked navigation option (window-shopping is content); no gold requires, so it never greys. Placed at array index 5 (issue #50 inserted a paid alternate before it) -- AFTER the pitch/guile/report/smooth options so the first-visible option (pitch fresh / report post-fight / smooth for wrong_order) stays at visible position 0 for every confirm-at-0 script. The buy options with their gold gate live in the 'shop' node.

stage-2 hub topic, requires-ONLY (progress-gated, hidden until crate_returned). Appended AFTER 'Just visiting.' (array end) so it can never shift the visible index of any earlier option in any canonical script -- it only ever appears LAST in the visible list.

stage-3 hub topic (the OBLIQUE necklace reveal -- never says 'spellbook', user gate per stage-tables.md). Also appended at array end for the same index-safety reason. heard_krshia_plans is a NEW counter banked on THIS option (effects live on options, never nodes).
options.text: You said the necklace was a promise.

options._comment: The sell picker's entry point (ratified selling mechanic). ALWAYS-visible, ALWAYS-unlocked (no requires/hide_when -- window-shopping is content, same as 'What's on the stall today?' above): the picker itself (WIShop.build_sell_graph, opened via the open_sell_picker effect signal, same deferred-swap shape as the Request Board's 'Take on a posting.') handles the zero-sellable-items case with its own Krshia-flavored line, so this option never needs to hide for an empty pack. Appended at array end so no earlier option's visible index shifts (same index-safety reason as the two stage-gated topics above).
options.text: I've a few things I don't need. Buying?

krshia_tribe.speaker: Krshia
krshia_tribe.text: My tribe, yes. Plains east and south of here: many hearths, one name. A Gnoll in a city is still her tribe's Gnoll; the distance changes nothing that matters. The necklace is not decoration. It is a promise I carry.

krshia_tribe_two.speaker: Krshia
krshia_tribe_two.text: Ask me when you have known me longer than one crate. A promise spoken cheap gets spent cheap. This is true of coin and truer of words.

krshia_plans.speaker: Krshia
krshia_plans.text: So you remembered. Hrr. Then hear a little of it. Every coin this stall clears past its keep goes toward something for the tribes. Something Gnolls have been told we cannot have, and are done being told. There is a gathering, some years off. I mean to stand up at it with full hands. That stays between you, me, and the wool.

options.text: Full hands. I'd like to see that.

krshia_plans_two.speaker: Krshia
krshia_plans_two.text: You will, if the city behaves and the thieves stay bored. And you are now a keeper of Silverfang business. For you, the front-of-stall price is the back-of-stall price. Do not announce it.

shop.speaker: Krshia
shop.text: Silverfang goods. Best in Liscor, and I will hear no argument on it. Cheapest at the front, the good stock where a browsing hand drifts. Coin on the counter and it is yours. No discounts, no haggling. I remember faces.
shop._comment: Shop node. Each buy option pairs requires:{gold:price} (greys VISIBLE when broke -- the numeric affordability gate, never hidden) WITH effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}] (the buy contract: the requires gate is what guarantees the unconditional effect-list spend can never refuse while still granting the item). Gear/tool items only -- no consumable machinery. Prices in items.json; price bar (design 2026-07-05 s2/s5): a day's honest inn work (~4 gold) buys the entry charm in a day or two; the jerkin takes several. Price numerals in option text are diegetic (gold is a countable object per the ratified design, NOT a hidden stat -- opacity forbids STR/DEX, not coin).

options.text: That Silverfang hunting knife. Good steel. (15 gold)
The wool-lined cloak. The wet gets in, out on the road. (18 gold)

options._comment: Krshia's shop discount perk (krshia_friend_of_the_silverfangs stage), DIEGETIC-FIRST (issue #33 ruling): the accomplishment leg now ALSO requires heard_krshia_plans, so the discount waits for her 'front-of-stall price is the back-of-stall price' grant line (krshia_plans_two) to actually fire, not just the stage count. Requires COMBINES an accomplishment stage-gate with a gold affordability check in one dict (dialogue.gd's _meets is now a compound AND across recognized keys) -- the accomplishment leg alone controls hidden-until-met (via _meets_progress), so a broke-but-unlocked player sees these GREYED, never vanished (window-shopping is content). Complementary hide_when on the 4 full-price options above carries the SAME heard_krshia_plans leg, so full price stays visible through the stage-4-chat/crate-returned window until the grant line fires, then exactly one of each pair is ever visible. Prices per stage-tables.md/krshia_stages.json: charm 5->4, knife 15->13, cloak 18->16, jerkin 24->22.
options.text: The old charm-cord, friend's price. (4 gold)
That Silverfang hunting knife, friend's price. (13 gold)
The wool-lined cloak, friend's price. (16 gold)
The boiled-leather jerkin, friend's price. (22 gold)

charms.speaker: Krshia
charms.text: The charmed stock costs more because it does more. Wear too much of it at once and it starts to argue with itself, so choose with sense. Coin on the counter, same as the rest.
charms._comment: HAZARD 1: the 6 new accessories/tools that would have overflowed 'shop' past its grown-panel bound. Same buy contract as 'shop' (requires:{gold:price} + effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}]), cheapest-first ordering matching the shop's own convention, price named in each option's own text (the L5 dedup in dialogue.gd's _item_effect_lines strips WIEffectText's 'Worth N gold' line from the rendered effect_lines because the price is already spelled here). 'Back to the regular stall.' is the required fully-ungated exit (no requires/hide_when) back to 'shop'.

options.text: That copper ring. Can't hurt. (4 gold)
The handline, for the pond. (4 gold)
The stone-scale, the one under the counter. (35 gold)

options._comment: The attunement catalyst, 18g -- the ratified price band moved to 15-20g (a first playthrough reached this purchase with 19g; the chain must flow without board-grinding, boards stay OPTIONAL income), superseding the old 30-40g band. Do not tune elsewhere. Same buy-contract shape as every other charm (requires:{gold:price} + effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}]) plus one extra effect banking bought_catalyst (the chain's locked id) on purchase. No door_chain_started gate -- Krshia sells it to anyone asking; harmless if bought before the chain even starts, the recover beat just waits on it. Own reaction node (catalyst_sold) rather than the generic 'bought' text, since 'wear it, use it' reads wrong for a carried macguffin.
options.text: That piece under the far cloth. What is it? (18 gold)

catalyst_sold.speaker: Krshia
catalyst_sold.text: That one, I do not ask questions about. Silverfang trade brings stranger things than that through Liscor, and it always finds the buyer who was already looking for it. Yours now. Spend the rest of your coin on something that talks less.

bought.speaker: Krshia
bought.text: Sold. Wear it, use it, and do not bring it back to me broken expecting sympathy. Anything else catch your eye?

accepted.speaker: Krshia
accepted.text: Good. Sewer grates, south of here. Start there. Careful of teeth.

thanks.speaker: Krshia
thanks.text: Yes. This is mine. My thanks. Do not expect a discount, but my thanks.

smoothed.speaker: Krshia
smoothed.text: For the barmaid, then. She is prickly, that one, but she works. I have watched her learn it. The order goes out full, and no word of the shortfall reaches Erin from my stall. You speak plainly and you speak for a friend. That, I respect.

smoothed_paid.speaker: Krshia
smoothed_paid.text: Coin instead of words. Simpler, some days. The order goes out full and Erin hears nothing of the shortfall. We are square, you and I.
